_comment: The old additional_cost searched the ARSENAL for weapons/equipment/items -- none of which are ever there -- and 'destroyed_permanents_count' was a bare string amount, which resolves to 0, so the card created no Silver at all. The cost is optional, repeats, and its COUNT is the entire payoff; DESTROY_PERMANENTS_OPTIONAL covers all three and sees equipment in the slot zones, which a permanents-only scan misses.
